name: reflog
description: A lazygit-style side pane: every worktree of the repository and its local branches as rows you click. A worktree row moves the session there with /cd; a branch row shows its last commits and offers switch (clean tree only) or open worktree. Docked floor to ceiling beside the transcript in the fullscreen layout, above the prompt otherwise.

columns.title: Pane width
columns.description: Columns asked for the docked pane in the fullscreen layout (28-120); a width you drag it to wins

maxBranches.title: Branches listed
maxBranches.description: How many local branches to list, most recently committed first; 0 lists all

maxCommits.title: Commits in history graph
maxCommits.description: How many commits to draw in the history graph, newest first; 0 draws all

maxFiles.title: Files in commit popup
maxFiles.description: How many changed files to list in a commit's popup; 0 lists all

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when the session starts; the engine keeps an unasked pane hidden below 144 columns
